description: This file defines the DefaultAccessControlService class, which implements access control and permission checking logic for the Thingsboard platform, managing permissions based on user authority levels.

classes.name: DefaultAccessControlService
classes.description: Implements permission checking logic for user actions based on authority levels and resource types.

methods.name: checkPermission
methods.description: Checks if a user has permission to perform an operation on a resource; throws exception if not.

methods.name: hasPermission
methods.description: Returns whether a user has permission to perform an operation on a resource.

methods.name: checkPermission (overloaded)
methods.description: Checks permission for a user on a specific entity within a resource context; throws exception if not.

methods.name: hasPermission (overloaded)
methods.description: Returns whether a user has permission for a specific entity within a resource context.

methods.name: getPermissionChecker
methods.description: Retrieves the PermissionChecker for a given authority and resource; throws exception if not found.

methods.name: permissionDenied
methods.description: Throws a ThingsboardException indicating permission denial.
